title: PromptScript Eval Comparison v1

$schema.description: Schema URL, the version tag of a standalone comparison; absent inside a report.

tolerance.description: Pass-rate drop that counts as a regression.

regression.description: Whether any case regressed or a pass rate dropped beyond the tolerance

entries.description: Entries sorted by suite name, then model order

description: Comparison of a candidate report against a baseline, version 1: the JSON output of a standalone compare, or `comparison` inside a report.

passRateDelta.description: Candidate pass rate minus baseline pass rate

costUsdDelta.description: Candidate cost minus baseline cost in USD, when both reports carry a cost

latencyP95MsDelta.description: Candidate p95 latency minus baseline p95 latency in milliseconds

regressions.description: Cases that passed in the baseline and not in the candidate

fixes.description: Cases that passed in the candidate and not in the baseline

onlyInBaseline.description: Case ids only the baseline has

onlyInCandidate.description: Case ids only the candidate has

EvalComparisonEntryV1.description: Comparison of one suite and model entry between two reports.
